# ModelRef

> **Kind:** component · **Registry:** world · **Folder:** [`src/logic/components/`](../folders/src-logic-components.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/components/model_ref.h`](../../../src/logic/components/model_ref.h)

## Summary

A glTF path and tint to draw at the entity's Transform.

## Description

Scene-level model reference by path under resources/; headless runs ignore it. In the current code only WorldViewSys reads it, and only its `color` (the mesh is chosen from RigidBody::shape); nothing resolves `path` into a ModelRenderable yet. Created from scene JSON and by BoxDropSys::init (box: models/primitives/box.gltf; capsule: models/primitives/capsule, a path with no file under resources/).

## Scene JSON

"ModelRef": { "path": "<required, non-empty>", "color": [r, g, b, a] }

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `std::string` | "" | model path under resources/, required in JSON |
| `color` | `glm::vec4` | (1, 1, 1, 1) | RGBA tint |
